ideas.title: Following the Money in Government Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails behind government investigations, including the Mar-a-Lago investigation and the Minnesota aid fraud investigation.
questions: What are the financial implications of these investigations?
How can we track the flow of money in these cases?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can gain a deeper understanding of the motivations and actions of those involved in these investigations. This can help to uncover potential corruption and ensure that those responsible are held accountable.
